bound.walk: copy the one printed URL/api POST route from the official Sandnes kommune API docs; join the docs origin to the printed /api path; do not invent process slugs or extra endpoints; fetch POSTs the GraphiQL default_query printed on the same host
bound.how: pda ingest --source sandnes --limit 1. The official docs page prints URL/api as the POST request route. GraphiQL on the same host prints graphql_endpoint /api and the default_query for participatoryProcesses titles. The adapter lists that one route. Native id is api. access_path is https://medvirkning.sandnes.kommune.no/api.
